elements.name: GateCanopy
elements.evidence: Long gable canopy over the gate + booth: brown shingles, white sawtooth fascia trim ~0.25 m, stained timber board soffit (boards N-S), downlights. Length 11.9 m: column -> booth SW corner 7.2 m (065856484 f7.0 frontal: 7.2; f3.5: 7.4-7.8; 065835543 bearings: 6.7; old-site elevation 8.2 but edge-compressed: it shows the booth 11 pct narrower than its 21.2-course tile count), cantilever 0.5 m west of the column (065835543: 0.3; f3.5: 0.85; old-site 0.7), 0.75 m past the booth east face (old-site). Depth 3.45 m (Google z20 roof -96.8..-100.2 at x 151.6-156.2, rest under pine / elm crowns; = booth 3.10 + eaves 0.15 N / 0.20 S). Soffit = booth wall top 21.5 +- 0.5 courses = 3.40 m. Pitch 26-30 deg from the apparent ridge rise over the fascia (065856484 f7.0: 27; old-site photo 27-33) -> 27. East end is a HIP over the booth, west end a gable cut (builder draws gable both ends). One white round column ~0.35 m (0.33-0.38) west end; depth position uncertain: old-site base height says near the gate line, f7.0 base height says ~2 m south of it, pano 2022 shows it south of the gate post -> placed on the centre line. East end rests on the booth. Absolute x +-0.8 m: column 150.2 (065835543.MP.jpg, EXIF 24 mm, camera 15.5 m from the north curb by zebra width 4.3 m = 787 px and a 1.6 m pedestrian, 1.0 m east of the zebra axis by the near-stripe edge) and 150.3 (065856484 f7.0, column 3.9 m west of a walker on the zebra axis); 2026 detail: flat boarded timber soffit (012258813, 012136583), white sawtooth trim ~0.2 m teeth at ~0.4 m pitch along both long eaves (~21 teeth from the column to the booth's west face, 012258813), column white with a maroon base ~0.55 m (web gate photo from the street)
